content:
[vc_row][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="For Job code: TS003"]

Assistant Professor

The Assistant professor’s responsibilities include teaching a requisite number of classes, providing guidance and supervision to graduate students, participating in departmental meetings, and providing academic support to Professors and other faculty members.

[/eikra-vc-text-title][vc_column_text]
The Job: Assistant Professor
Education: UG B.E Programs
    • B. E. / B. Tech. /  and M. E. / M. Tech. / M. S. or Integrated M. Tech. in relevant branch with first class or equivalent in any one of the degrees.
Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
    • BE / B.Tech and ME / M.Tech in relevant branch with First Class or equivalent either in BE / B.Tech or ME / M.Tech OR BE / B.Tech and MCA with First Class or equivalent in either BE / B.Tech or MCA OR MCA with First Class
Master of Business Administration (MBA)
    • First class or equivalent in Masters Degree in Business Administration or equivalent
Experience: UG B.E Programs
    • Minimum of 3-4 years of experience in teaching / research / industry. However fresher with exceptional academics can also apply.
Master of Computer Applications (MCA) 
    • 2 Years of relevant Experience
Master of Business Administration (MBA)
    • 2 years of relevant experience is desirable
Location: Mysuru
Employment Type: Permanent
Roles and Responsibilities: ACADEMIC
  • Classroom Instruction and Laboratory Instruction
  • Developing Learning Resource Material & Laboratory Development
  • Students Assessment & Evaluation including Examination work of the University.
  • Participation in the Co-curricular & Extra-Curricular Activities
  • Students Guidance & Counselling & helping their personal, ethical, moral and overall character development
  • Continuing Education Activities
  • Keeping abreast of new Knowledge and skills, help generate new knowledge and help dissemination of such knowledge through books, publications, etc.
  • Self-development through upgrading qualification, experience & Professional activities.
RESEARCH & CONSULTANCY
  • Research & Development Activities & Research Guidance
  • Industry sponsored projects
  • Providing Consultancy and Testing Services
  • Promotion of Industry Institution interaction
EXTENSION ACTIVITIES
  • Extension Services
  • Interaction with Industry and Society
  • Participation in Community Services
  • Providing R&D support and Consultancy services to Industry and other User agencies
  • Providing non-formal modes of education for the benefit of the Community
  • Promotion of entrepreneurship and job creation
  • Dissemination of knowledge
  • Providing Technical Support in areas of social relevance
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]
